overview: Trekora is a world-class Himalayan trekking and yatra platform for Uttarakhand and Himachal Pradesh. Features 40 treks and 16 yatras with interactive trail maps, GPS altitude profiles, detailed itineraries, booking, and premium travel content.
features: Interactive trail maps with GPS-accurate polylines and altitude profiles on all trek and yatra pages
40 Himalayan treks with full detail pages, booking, and itinerary downloads
16 yatra pages with spiritual significance, How to Reach transport info, and interactive maps
District-level destinations, long-form blogs, and SEO-optimized content
Sticky WhatsApp button, query modal, and lead capture on every page
